title: [29x]-Mismatch between Purchase Invoice Total in Lines and Statistics after VAT adjustment
summary: Fixed a mismatch between purchase invoice totals displayed on the lines subform and the statistics page when VAT amounts are manually adjusted with mixed VAT groups. The fix recalculates grouped VAT and synchronizes the subform totals.
key_points: VAT amounts on purchase invoice lines now correctly reflect manual adjustments made in the statistics page
Recalculation uses CalcVATAmountLines when VAT differences are detected on line items
Subform totals are overridden to ensure consistency with statistics calculations
Fix applies to BE, NA, and W1 layers
Test coverage added for document totals pages
quote: VAT Amount on the Purchase Invoice subform didn't reflect manual VAT adjustments from Statistics when mixed VAT groups were used.
